hikes.name: Garfield Peak
hikes.blurb: Switchbacks above the lodge to a peak on the rim, the whole blue lake and Wizard Island far below.

hikes.name: Mount Scott
hikes.blurb: The park's highest point: an old lookout on a peak that sees the whole caldera and the Cascades to Shasta.

hikes.name: The Watchman
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a lookout above the rim with the best sunset view of Wizard Island.

hikes.name: Cleetwood Cove
hikes.blurb: The only way down to the water: steep switchbacks to a rocky shore where people jump into the coldest blue lake.

hikes.name: Plaikni Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy forest walk to a falls spilling down a glacier-carved wall, wildflowers along its spray.

hikes.name: Discovery Point
hikes.blurb: Along the rim from the village to where the first settlers saw the lake.

hikes.name: Mount Thielsen
hikes.blurb: Up to the base of the Lightning Rod of the Cascades, a sharp pinnacle above Diamond Lake (the last pitch is a scramble).

hikes.name: Mount Bailey
hikes.blurb: A steep cinder climb to a crater rim across Diamond Lake from Mt Thielsen.

hikes.name: Boundary Springs
hikes.blurb: Along the infant Rogue River to where it pours out of the ground in mossy springs.

hikes.name: Lemolo Falls
hikes.blurb: Down the North Umpqua to a 100-foot falls thundering into a deep pool.

hikes.name: Union Peak
hikes.blurb: From Highway 62-Pacific Crest Trail Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to the top of Union Peak (7,668 ft), with about 1,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Witches Cauldron
hikes.blurb: From Wizard Island Trailhead, a 2.3-mile round trip to Witches Cauldron, with about 800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bald Top
hikes.blurb: From Red Blanket Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to the top of Bald Top (5,716 ft), with about 2,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Red Blanket Falls
hikes.blurb: From Red Blanket Trailhead, a 5.8-mile round trip to Red Blanket Falls, with about 1,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Rough Rider Falls
hikes.blurb: From Hamaker Trailhead, an 8.0-mile round trip to Rough Rider Falls, with about 1,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sawtooth Mountain
hikes.blurb: From June Lake/Middle Fork Trailhead, an 8.6-mile round trip to the top of Sawtooth Mountain (7,273 ft), with about 2,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Indigo Lake
hikes.blurb: From June Lake/Middle Fork Trailhead, a 4.1-mile round trip to Indigo Lake, with about 650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: June Lake
hikes.blurb: From June Lake/Middle Fork Trailhead, a 4.3-mile round trip to June Lake, with about 650 feet of climbing.
